texts.en:
Our Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.
Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive state.

We'll need to rebuild the Grand Archive in another system to continue our Specimen exhibitions.

texts.zh:
我们已经摧毁了[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢

我们可以从中取回一些有价值的标本。

此外，我们似乎还释放出了一些关在生态园里的太空兽群。很有可能它们会因为刚刚释放而变得既困惑又富有攻击性。
texts.en:
We have destroyed the Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] owned by the [from.GetName].

We were able to recover some of the valuable Specimens inside.

Additionally, we seem to have released some amount of captive Space Fauna from the Vivarium. It's possible they'll be aggressive and confused in their newly released state.
